change.description: Unify assistant model and tool execution on Pi Harness, enable general answers and site-first Tavily web research with configurable search budgets.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: General assistant answers now use Pi Harness with optional authorized site retrieval and Tavily web search. Stable knowledge remains answerable without site evidence. Existing route, ownership, quota and job contracts remain compatible; web is an additive citation source in unconstrained SQLite text storage.

evidence.command: bun test --isolate src/server/assistant/pi-answer.test.ts: real Pi Harness tool loop, Hikari HTTP auth, web citations, quota deduplication, history, stop and truncated-stream checks
bun test --isolate src/server/assistant/runtime.test.ts: durable job, lease, cancellation and restart boundaries
bun test --isolate src/lib/assistant-storage.test.ts: application-owned history, quotas and deletion compatibility
